process FASTVEP_ANNOTATE {
    tag "$meta.id"
    label 'process_low'

    conda "${moduleDir}/environment.yml"
    container "${workflow.containerEngine in ['singularity', 'apptainer'] && !task.ext.singularity_pull_docker_container
        ? 'https://community-cr-prod.seqera.io/docker/registry/v2/blobs/sha256/c3/c3dda8b0c7fd437d6a0e82050ea78debf20dfbcb566dd8b63dbfecef51ae5979/data'
        : 'community.wave.seqera.io/library/fastvep_htslib:1cb9b1d86ed7c379'}"

    input:
    tuple val(meta), path(vcf), path(custom_extra_files)
    tuple val(meta2), path(gff3)
    tuple val(meta3), path(fasta), path(fai)
    path(sa_files, stageAs: 'fastvep_sa/*')
    tuple val(meta4), path(cache_dir)
    val output_format

    output:
    tuple val(meta), path("${prefix}.vcf.gz")           , optional: true, emit: vcf
    tuple val(meta), path("${prefix}.tab.gz")           , optional: true, emit: tab
    tuple val(meta), path("${prefix}.json.gz")          , optional: true, emit: json
    tuple val(meta2), path("${gff3}.fastvep.cache")     , optional: true, emit: transcript_cache
    tuple val("${task.process}"), val('fastvep'), eval("fastvep --version | sed 's/^fastvep //'"), topic: versions, emit: versions_fastvep
    tuple val("${task.process}"), val('htslib'), eval("bgzip --version | sed '1!d; s/.* //'"), topic: versions, emit: versions_htslib

    when:
    task.ext.when == null || task.ext.when

    script:
    def args = task.ext.args ?: ''
    def args2 = task.ext.args2 ?: ''
    prefix = task.ext.prefix ?: "${meta.id}_annotated"
    if (!(output_format in ['vcf', 'tab', 'json'])) {
        error "FASTVEP_ANNOTATE: invalid output_format '${output_format}'. Must be one of: vcf, tab, json."
    }
    def fasta_arg = fasta ? "--fasta \"${fasta}\"" : ''
    def sa_arg = sa_files ? "--sa-dir fastvep_sa" : ''
    def cache_dir_arg = cache_dir ? "--cache-dir \"${cache_dir}\"" : ''
    """
    fastvep \\
        annotate \\
        --input "${vcf}" \\
        --output "${prefix}.${output_format}" \\
        --output-format ${output_format} \\
        --gff3 "${gff3}" \\
        ${fasta_arg} \\
        ${sa_arg} \\
        ${cache_dir_arg} \\
        --no-progress \\
        ${args}

    bgzip \\
        --threads ${task.cpus} \\
        ${args2} \\
        "${prefix}.${output_format}"
    """

    stub:
    prefix = task.ext.prefix ?: "${meta.id}_annotated"
    if (!(output_format in ['vcf', 'tab', 'json'])) {
        error "FASTVEP_ANNOTATE: invalid output_format '${output_format}'. Must be one of: vcf, tab, json."
    }
    """
    echo "" | bgzip > "${prefix}.${output_format}.gz"
    touch "${gff3}.fastvep.cache"
    """
}

---
name: "nf-core/fastvep/annotate"
description: "Annotate variants with predicted consequences using fastVEP, a fast\
  \ Rust reimplementation of Ensembl VEP"
keywords:
- "vcf"
- "annotation"
- "variant effect prediction"
- "vep"
- "genomics"
tools:
- fastvep:
    description: "A high-performance variant effect predictor with clinical database\
      \ integration, written in Rust"
    homepage: "https://github.com/Huang-lab/fastVEP/blob/master/README.md"
    documentation: "https://github.com/Huang-lab/fastVEP/blob/master/README.md"
    tool_dev_url: "https://github.com/Huang-lab/fastVEP"
    licence:
    - "Apache-2.0"
    identifier: ""
- htslib:
    description: "C library for high-throughput sequencing data formats"
    homepage: "https://github.com/samtools/htslib"
    documentation: "https://www.htslib.org/doc/"
    tool_dev_url: "https://github.com/samtools/htslib"
    doi: "10.1093/gigascience/giab007"
    publication:
      author: "Bonfield, J. K., Marshall, J., Danecek, P., Li, H., Ohan, V., Whitwham,\
        \ A., Keane, T. & Davies, R. M."
      year: 2021
      title: "HTSlib: C library for reading/writing high-throughput sequencing data"
      source: "GigaScience"
    licence:
    - "MIT"
    identifier: "biotools:htslib"
input:
- - meta:
      type: "map"
      description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
        \ ]`\n"
  - vcf:
      type: "file"
      description: "VCF file to annotate, optionally gzip compressed"
      pattern: "*.{vcf,vcf.gz}"
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3016"
  - custom_extra_files:
      type: "file"
      description: "Optional sample-specific files to be staged and used with `ext.args`\n\
        (e.g. path to a gene panel file)\n"
      ontologies: []
- - meta2:
      type: "map"
      description: "Groovy Map containing annotation information\ne.g. `[ id:'genome'\
        \ ]`\n"
  - gff3:
      type: "file"
      description: "GFF3 file with the transcript models used for annotation"
      pattern: "*.{gff,gff3}"
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_1975"
- - meta3:
      type: "map"
      description: "Groovy Map containing reference information\ne.g. `[ id:'genome'\
        \ ]`\n"
  - fasta:
      type: "file"
      description: "Optional reference genome FASTA file"
      pattern: "*.{fa,fasta,fna}"
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_1929"
  - fai:
      type: "file"
      description: "Optional reference genome FASTA index file"
      pattern: "*.fai"
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3326"
- sa_files:
    type: "file"
    description: "Optional fastVEP supplementary annotation files (.osa, .osa2, .osi,\
      \ .oga),\nstaged into a `fastvep_sa/` directory and passed with `--sa-dir`.\
      \ You can generate these annotation files with `fastvep sa-build`\n"
    pattern: "*.{osa,osa2,osi,oga}"
    ontologies: []
- - meta4:
      type: "map"
      description: "Groovy Map containing VEP cache information\ne.g. `[ id:'115_WBcel235'\
        \ ]`\n"
  - cache_dir:
      type: "directory"
      description: "Optional VEP cache directory for known-variant lookup.\n"
      ontologies: []
- output_format:
    type: "string"
    description: "Output format, passed to `--output-format`. One of `vcf`, `tab`\
      \ or `json`.\nThe output is always bgzip compressed.\n"
output:
  vcf:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
          \ ]`\n"
    - ${prefix}.vcf.gz:
        type: "file"
        description: "Annotated bgzip compressed VCF file, produced when `output_format`\
          \ is `vcf`"
        pattern: "*.vcf.gz"
        ontologies:
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3016"
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3989"
  tab:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
          \ ]`\n"
    - ${prefix}.tab.gz:
        type: "file"
        description: "Annotated variants in bgzip compressed tab-delimited format,\
          \ produced when `output_format` is `tab`"
        pattern: "*.tab.gz"
        ontologies:
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3475"
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3989"
  json:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
          \ ]`\n"
    - ${prefix}.json.gz:
        type: "file"
        description: "Annotated variants in bgzip compressed JSON format, produced\
          \ when `output_format` is `json`"
        pattern: "*.json.gz"
        ontologies:
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3464"
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3989"
  transcript_cache:
  - - meta2:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing annotation information\ne.g. `[ id:'genome'\
          \ ]`\n"
    - ${gff3}.fastvep.cache:
        type: "file"
        description: "Binary transcript cache built by fastVEP from the GFF3"
        pattern: "*.fastvep.cache"
        ontologies:
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_2333"
  versions_fastvep:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - fastvep:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the tool"
    - fastvep --version | sed 's/^fastvep //':
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"
  versions_htslib:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - htslib:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the tool"
    - bgzip --version | sed '1!d; s/.* //':
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"
topics:
  versions:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - fastvep:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the tool"
    - fastvep --version | sed 's/^fastvep //':
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - htslib:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the tool"
    - bgzip --version | sed '1!d; s/.* //':
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"
